])

num_cells = mesh.number_of_cells()

node_to_cell = mesh.node_to_cell()

edge_boundary_flag = mesh.edge_boundary_flag()
face_boundary_flag = mesh.face_boundary_flag()
cell_boundary_flag = mesh.cell_boundary_flag()

boundary_edge_index = mesh.boundary_edge_index()
boundary_face_index = mesh.boundary_face_index()
boundary_cell_index = mesh.boundary_cell_index()

# Plotting

plt.title('TetrahedronMesh with Node, Edge, and Cell Indices')
plt.show()
